home.lead: Developer focused on integrations, APIs, and products that solve real problems — with clean code and a healthy dose of curiosity.

about.intro: Every experience brought a skill that I now carry into technology.
about.story1: Passionate about technology and programming, I work developing a systems integration platform using APIs. I also bring experience in team leadership and customer service.
about.story2: From Northeast Brazil, father, husband, and programmer. I served in the Army and worked in many fields before finding in software a way to combine reasoning, creativity, and impact. This background taught me adaptability, collaboration, and a constant desire to learn.
about.valuesText: I believe in clear technology, built as a team and designed for those who will use it.
